title: water extinguish
description: Extinguishes burning players when they drink a water bottle.
body:
# Water Extinguish

**Water Extinguish** is a small quality-of-life datapack that lets players extinguish themselves by drinking a water bottle while on fire.

When a burning player drinks a water bottle, the datapack automatically triggers a water splash effect and puts the fire out.  
It is lightweight, simple, and designed to feel natural in survival gameplay.

## Features

- Extinguish yourself by drinking a water bottle
- Only activates when the player is actually on fire
- Lightweight and server-friendly
- Includes simple enable / disable / status functions

## Functions

- `/function water_extinguish:on` — enable the datapack
- `/function water_extinguish:off` — disable the datapack
- `/function water_extinguish:status` — check current status

## Notes

This datapack is meant to be a simple survival-friendly utility and does not add new items, blocks, or complicated mechanics.
